crossRefs.note: A gentle answer turns away wrath, but a harsh word stirs up anger.
The plans of the heart belong to man, but the answer of the tongue is from Yahweh.
He who answers before he hears, that is folly and shame to him.
An honest answer is like a kiss on the lips.
But Peter began, and explained to them in order, saying,
So, then, my beloved brothers, let every man be swift to hear, slow to speak, and slow to anger;
But sanctify the Lord God in your hearts. Always be ready to give an answer to everyone who asks you a reason…
Moreover you shall provide out of all the people able men which fear God: men of truth, hating unjust gain; and place…
But you, Bethlehem Ephrathah, being small among the clans of Judah, out of you one will come out to me that is to be…

translations.web: Then the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the half-tribe of Manasseh answered, and spoke to the heads of the thousands of Israel,
translations.bsb: Then the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh answered the leaders of the clans of Israel:
translations.kjv: Then the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the half tribe of Manasseh answered, and said unto the heads of the thousands of Israel,
translations.asv: Then the children of Reuben and the children of Gad and the half-tribe of Manasseh answered, and spake unto the heads of the thousands of Israel,
